ev_0005.summary: Full circle center O(543,538), r=472 (CV circle_01). A(542,66), B(71,538), C(1015,538), H(543,1010) and D(188,226) lie on the circle (|OD|=472.6); BC is a horizontal diameter. F(801,324), G(758,440), E(330,279) lie inside the circle. Unnamed point X(721,538) is the intersection of line FH with BC. Collinear: D,E,G,C on one line (DC, slope ~0.377; E and G checked within 1-2 px); F,G,H on one line (FH). Right angle at G between FH and DC is VERIFIED by detect_right_angle_marker (vertex 757.7,440.3; both arms ink coverage 1.0), so FH is perpendicular to DC. O-G is NOT perpendicular to either DC or FH (angle about 44 deg from DC normal, cosines -0.73 and -0.71), and OG is a plain segment from O to G. A-H is not drawn (A-H would be the vertical diameter, which is absent). Segments drawn: AC, AB, HB, HC, AD, DB, DC, FH, BC, OG.
